brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.

requirements.evidence: Single full hex base at 0,0,0 enclosed with full top cover (cover:0,0,0;full;top) and full bottom cover (cover:0,0,0;full;bottom) plus 6 side caps (cap:0,0,0;*;30/90/150/210/270/330) - all faces closed, forming sealed single-cell box for board.

requirements.requirement: Louvred vent so board can breathe
requirements.evidence: Port louvre installed at 0,0,0 slot 0 (port:0#0,0#0 stem hex-port-louvre) - provides weather-resistant ventilation through closed side wall.

finish.summary: Built minimal single-cell closed enclosure: full hex base with top+bottom covers and all 6 caps closing sides, plus one hex-port-louvre for breathing. check_build ok, meshClash clear, no open faces.
